description:
Vantara is a workspace-scoped AI call application platform with a governed Model Context Protocol interface.

After OAuth authorisation, ChatGPT can work with the authenticated user's own Vantara Setup, leads, campaign performance, call intelligence, lead discovery and enrichment workflows, selected LinkedIn lead context, calendar actions, and guarded campaign controls.

Vantara enforces workspace identity server-side and preserves its existing DNC, duplicate, campaign, caller, confirmation, audit, and persistence safeguards.

Paid-provider actions and production mutations require explicit confirmation.

Vantara MCP does not expose raw Supabase access, provider secrets, LinkedIn session credentials, arbitrary one-off outbound calls, or RTP/audio/media controls.
